methods.why: Spotwind /locations prints GeoJSON feature names (DKE, DKW, FE, …). Those are not a numeric time series with a year-like period field. methods/ was not edited.

notes: Ids are copied from printed swagger path last segments. access_path is swagger origin + printed basePath + path. No spotwind id was written onto a met, nowcast, airquality, tidalwater, oceanforecast, sunrise, radar, or datanorge row.
License is the printed swagger CC BY 4.0 URL http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0. Publisher is null: the spec does not print a publisher.
Original harvested swagger metadata stays in harvested_payloads. Fetch writes observations only. enrichments count stayed 0.
